events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe header and placeholder email call sites
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | cut -c1-220; grep -n -E "isPlaceholderEmail" -r cloud/src | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the production admin access method and placeholder refusal call sites
events.input: $ grep -rn -l "revops-centre.growthcluborg" app/scripts cloud/scripts scripts 2>/dev/null | head -12; f=$(ls app/scripts/zoom_support_check.mjs cloud/scripts/zoom_support_check.mjs scripts/zoom_support_check.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "F=$f"; [ -n "$f" ] && grep -n -E "KEY|keychain|security |\.dev\.vars|process\.env" "$f" | cut -c1-200 | head -20; grep -n -E "placeholderRefused|isPlaceholderEmail|131" cloud/src/util.ts | head; grep -rn "placeholderRefused\|refusePlaceholder" cloud/src | cut -c1-170 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read placeholder helper and how live scripts get the admin key
events.input: $ sed -n 115,133p cloud/src/util.ts | cut -c1-220; grep -rn "skipSignup\|blockedSignup" cloud/src | cut -c1-170 | head; n=$(sed -n 130p cloud/src/util.ts | grep -o "const [a-zA-Z]*" | cut -d' ' -f2); echo "NAME=$n"; grep -n -E "KEY|keychain|security |dev\.vars|process\.env" app/scripts/e2e-tantra-reminders-live.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -12; find . -name "zoom_support_check*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: List admin API routes for Zoom, calendar and attendees
events.input: $ grep -n -E 'path === "(zoom|calendar|attendees)[^"]*"|startsWith\("(zoom|attendees)/|zoom/(check|settings|attendance|live|pull)' cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/admin*.ts cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-210 | head -40; ls ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key >/dev/null && echo keyfile-ok
